name: Iwakura Amane
source:
Aria's father. A wealthy and gentle gentleman from the former nobility. He runs a trading company and keeps himself busy every day.

Concerned about Ichiko's situation, whom he had only just met, he decided to welcome her into the Iwakura household as a maid. He dotes on his daughter, Aria, and spoils her.

[From the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/iwakura-aria/]official website[/url]]
